limitations: The local BSTLD mirror contains 105 labelled training frames and 114 unlabelled/no-active-light test frames, not the full dataset.
Only one active yellow source box is present; 24 of 25 yellow samples are deterministic variants of that same source.
Yellow held-out samples share their source with tuning variants, so yellow accuracy must not be described as independent.
crop_policy: Tight target crop with 35% padding on each side; other labelled traffic lights are masked; minimum side is upscaled to 96 px.
